performance.verdict: Spend throttled intentionally; intake seat gap is the real scaling blocker.

findings.text: Booking bot battle-test was due 2026-07-31 — no completed event recorded; 25 days overdue with no confirmation of live status.
Dispatch intake owner unconfirmed since Vivian left 7/7; speed-to-lead automations may point at an empty GHL seat, blocking the scale-back-up gate entirely.
Leads feed shows 0 across all 28 days; GHL logged 41 opportunities created vs 80 contacts — CPL is unmeasurable from ad data, not a spend failure.
Google spend is erratic: 5 zero-spend days in the last 28 (e.g. 7/29, 8/02, 8/26) with bursts up to $130.18 on 8/15 — pattern consistent with throttled daily budget, not campaign failure.
GBP actions dropped to 0 on both 8/23 and 8/24 (last 2 days of series); 3-day avg (0.67) vs prior 3-day avg (6.33) — possible Windsor data lag per SOW, not confirmed organic decline yet.

suggestions.text: Confirm new intake owner, GHL login, and after-hours coverage — unblocks the scale gate; no budget move until resolved.
suggestions.monday_update: Vivian left 7/7 and the GHL intake seat is unconfirmed, blocking all budget scale-up per the SOW gate. Contact Xavier or Nader to name the new dispatch owner, verify their GHL login is active, and confirm after-hours coverage is assigned. Success check: named owner confirmed in writing with active GHL access by 2026-08-29. Until this is done, speed-to-lead automations may be firing into a dead seat and losing the 11 Google Ads conversions recorded in the 28-day window.
